meta.title: Dead Signal Network story progression blueprint
meta.principle: The network should feel useful, social, and defensibly strange before it becomes impossible.

globalRules.earlyStageRule: Every anomaly through stage three retains at least one mundane interpretation.
globalRules.repetitionRule: A clue becomes meaningful only after it appears in at least two different systems or cases.
globalRules.contradictionRule: Institutional records may contradict one another, but the interface never explains the contradiction for the visitor.
protectedReveals: The full Wren’s End expedition manifest
Meredith Bell’s communications with Wren’s End
The identity of the person sacrificed to contain the town
Proof that the signal is addressing the visitor
globalRules.tone: Professional institutional language surrounding chaotic, funny, compassionate community behavior.

stages.label: Ordinary Strange
stages.visitorExperience: DSN appears to be a credible paranormal association with a lively, occasionally ridiculous community.
allowedSignals: Debunked cases with one unresolved detail
withhold: Wren’s End as a named location

stages.label: Administrative Errors
stages.visitorExperience: Counts disagree, sealed records surface, and timestamps violate the order of events.
allowedSignals: DSN-0000 appears outside the result count

stages.label: Personal Impossibilities
stages.visitorExperience: The errors attach themselves to real people: missing members update files and memorialized accounts perform staff actions.
allowedSignals: A dead account restores a record
A vanished founder’s credentials remain active
Forecasts display a partial place name
withhold: Confirmation that the missing are alive

stages.label: Geographic Impossibility
stages.visitorExperience: Independent records all point toward a town absent from every map, yet ordinary residents post from it.
allowedSignals: Wren’s End named in unrelated systems
Weather and transit data resolve to the town

stages.label: Institutional Concealment
stages.visitorExperience: The omissions resolve into policy. DSN leadership knowingly erased a catastrophic 2019 investigation.
allowedSignals: The expedition’s request to be erased

stages.label: Founder Betrayal
stages.visitorExperience: The current leader’s protection of DSN is revealed as manipulation, secret contact, and a human sacrifice made to contain the town.
withhold: Whether the visitor has already been noticed

stages.label: The Signal Recognizes You
stages.visitorExperience: The interface stops behaving like an archive and begins behaving like a participant in the visitor’s investigation.
allowedSignals: An invitation addressed to the visitor
withhold: A single definitive explanation of Wren’s End

progressionState.implementationNote: The current public checkpoint renders stages one and two. Later stages should unlock through repeated investigation, never a single click.

casePlacement.laterStageRule: Existing cases gain additional evidence and cross-links as the visitor progresses; do not replace their ordinary public summaries.
